care.title: Looking after it
care.lead: How to clean and store the materials you will find on our shelves.

castIron.title: Cast iron
castIron.body: Wash with hot water and a brush, then dry it straight away and wipe a thin film of cooking oil over the surface while it is still warm. Left wet or soaked, bare cast iron rusts.

enamel.title: Enamel
enamel.body: Use a soft sponge or a nylon brush. Metal scourers and abrasive powders scratch the glaze, so soak stubborn residue in warm soapy water instead.

nonStick.title: Non-stick
nonStick.body: Cook on low to medium heat and turn food with wooden or silicone tools. High heat and metal utensils wear the coating away.

glass.title: Glass
glass.body: Avoid sudden temperature changes: don't pour boiling water into a cold glass or set a hot dish down on a cold, wet surface. Let it cool before washing.
